title: Default terminal falls back to an integrated profile of the platform
why: Upstream, when defaultProfile is missing or does not fit the current platform, the default terminal command opens the profile picker. The edit opens the first integrated profile of the current platform (Profile.defaultOfType("integrated", profiles, CURRENT)) instead. The picker opens only when no such profile exists. From 0.7.0, the initial settings of each platform select a profile of that platform, and the settings migration 0003-linux-terminal-default fixes migrated Linux Flints. This entry stays for one release to protect migrated Linux Flints whose settings still name the macOS profile.
